description: This file defines classes and methods for managing employee data and timesheet entries in an Odoo (OpenERP) module, including handling of analytic lines, employee product info, and related operations.

classes.name: hr_employee
classes.description: Extends hr.employee with additional product and journal fields.

classes.name: hr_analytic_timesheet
classes.description: Represents a timesheet line inheriting from account.analytic.line, with methods for managing timesheet entries and related data.

methods.name: unlink
methods.description: Deletes the timesheet and associated analytic lines.

methods.name: on_change_unit_amount
methods.description: Handles changes to the unit amount, updating related analytic line data.

methods.name: _getEmployeeProduct
methods.description: Retrieves the product associated with the current employee.

methods.name: _getEmployeeUnit
methods.description: Retrieves the unit of measure for the employee's product.

methods.name: _getGeneralAccount
methods.description: Retrieves the expense account for the employee's product.

methods.name: _getAnalyticJournal
methods.description: Retrieves the analytic journal associated with the employee.

methods.name: on_change_account_id
methods.description: Placeholder for handling account ID changes.

methods.name: on_change_date
methods.description: Warns when changing the date of a timesheet entry.

methods.name: create
methods.description: Creates a new timesheet entry, with error handling for missing analytic journal or account.

methods.name: on_change_user_id
methods.description: Updates related fields when the user ID changes.
